mapper.select: SELECT ID FROM MB_SERVICE_ITEM WHERE ID = (SELECT MIN(ID) FROM MB_SERVICE_ITEM) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MB_SERVICE_ITEM WHERE ID = #{serviceId} AND CATEGORY <> 'DELETED' ) FOR UPDATE

SELECT R.RESERVATION_DATE_TIME, S.DURATION_MINUTES FROM MB_RESERVATION R JOIN MB_SERVICE_ITEM S ON S.ID = R.SERVICE_ID WHERE R.STATUS IN ('REQUESTED', 'CONFIRMED') AND R.RESERVATION_DATE_TIME >= #{reservationDate, jdbcType=DATE} AND R.RESERVATION_DATE_TIME < #{reservationDate, jdbcType=DATE} + 1 ORDER BY R.RESERVATION_DATE_TIME
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MB_HOLIDAY WHERE HOLIDAY_DATE = #{reservationDate}
SELECT HOLIDAY_DATE AS holidayDate, REASON AS reason FROM MB_HOLIDAY ORDER BY HOLIDAY_DATE
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO MB_HOLIDAY H USING (SELECT #{holidayDate} AS HOLIDAY_DATE, #{reason} AS REASON FROM DUAL) V ON (H.HOLIDAY_DATE = V.HOLIDAY_DATE) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET H.REASON = V.REASON WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (HOLIDAY_DATE, REASON) VALUES (V.HOLIDAY_DATE, V.REASON)
mapper.select: SELECT ID AS id, DAY_OF_WEEK AS dayOfWeek, IS_OPEN AS open, OPEN_TIME AS openTime, CLOSE_TIME AS closeTime FROM MB_BUSINESS_HOUR ORDER BY DAY_OF_WEEK
SELECT ID AS id, DAY_OF_WEEK AS dayOfWeek, IS_OPEN AS open, OPEN_TIME AS openTime, CLOSE_TIME AS closeTime FROM MB_BUSINESS_HOUR WHERE DAY_OF_WEEK = #{dayOfWeek}
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO MB_BUSINESS_HOUR B USING ( SELECT #{dayOfWeek} AS DAY_OF_WEEK, #{open} AS IS_OPEN, #{openTime} AS OPEN_TIME, #{closeTime} AS CLOSE_TIME FROM DUAL ) V ON (B.DAY_OF_WEEK = V.DAY_OF_WEEK) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET B.IS_OPEN = V.IS_OPEN, B.OPEN_TIME = V.OPEN_TIME, B.CLOSE_TIME = V.CLOSE_TIME, B.UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (DAY_OF_WEEK, IS_OPEN, OPEN_TIME, CLOSE_TIME) VALUES (V.DAY_OF_WEEK, V.IS_OPEN, V.OPEN_TIME, V.CLOSE_TIME)
mapper.select: SELECT R.ID AS id, R.SERVICE_ID AS serviceId, S.NAME AS serviceName, S.CATEGORY AS serviceCategory, R.RESERVATION_DATE_TIME AS reservationDateTime, R.STATUS AS status, R.MEMO AS memo FROM MB_RESERVATION R JOIN MB_SERVICE_ITEM S ON S.ID = R.SERVICE_ID WHERE R.CUSTOMER_ID = #{customerId} ORDER BY R.RESERVATION_DATE_TIME DESC

SELECT R.ID, R.SERVICE_ID, S.NAME AS SERVICE_NAME, S.CATEGORY AS SERVICE_CATEGORY, S.DURATION_MINUTES, R.CUSTOMER_NAME, R.CUSTOMER_EMAIL, R.CUSTOMER_PHONE, R.RESERVATION_DATE_TIME, R.NO_SHOW_POLICY_AGREED, R.STATUS, R.MEMO FROM MB_RESERVATION R JOIN MB_SERVICE_ITEM S ON S.ID = R.SERVICE_ID WHERE R.ID = #{reservationId} AND R.CUSTOMER_ID = #{customerId}
mapper.update: UPDATE MB_RESERVATION SET SERVICE_ID = #{serviceId}, RESERVATION_DATE_TIME = #{reservationDateTime, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.LocalDateTimeTypeHandler}, MEMO = #{memo}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE ID = #{reservationId} AND CUSTOMER_ID = #{customerId} AND STATUS IN ('REQUESTED', 'CONFIRMED') AND RESERVATION_DATE_TIME > SYSTIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT R.ID, R.SERVICE_ID, S.NAME AS SERVICE_NAME, S.CATEGORY AS SERVICE_CATEGORY, S.DURATION_MINUTES, R.CUSTOMER_NAME, R.CUSTOMER_EMAIL, R.CUSTOMER_PHONE, R.RESERVATION_DATE_TIME, R.NO_SHOW_POLICY_AGREED, R.STATUS, R.MEMO FROM MB_RESERVATION R JOIN MB_SERVICE_ITEM S ON S.ID = R.SERVICE_ID ORDER BY R.RESERVATION_DATE_TIME DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT R.ID, R.SERVICE_ID, S.NAME AS SERVICE_NAME, S.CATEGORY AS SERVICE_CATEGORY, S.DURATION_MINUTES, R.CUSTOMER_NAME, R.CUSTOMER_EMAIL, R.CUSTOMER_PHONE, R.RESERVATION_DATE_TIME, R.NO_SHOW_POLICY_AGREED, R.STATUS, R.MEMO FROM MB_RESERVATION R JOIN MB_SERVICE_ITEM S ON S.ID = R.SERVICE_ID WHERE R.ID = #{reservationId}
mapper.update: UPDATE MB_RESERVATION SET STATUS = #{status}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE ID = #{reservationId}
